invariants.rationale: Since the method returns null for b.doubleValue() == 0.0, at method exit b.doubleValue() != 0.0 holds when result is non-null.
At method exit, when returning a value (not null), result must be non-null.

meta.value: Method returns null only when b.doubleValue() == 0.0

invariants.expression: a instanceof Integer || a instanceof Double
invariants.rationale: Since the method throws if a is neither Integer nor Double, at method exit a is Integer or Double if result is non-null.
When a is Integer, result is Integer value; so types match.

meta.value: Result type matches input type when a is Integer

invariants.rationale: When a is Double, result is Double value; so types match.

meta.value: Result type matches input type when a is Double
